---
title: "Polynomial Regression in UX"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(MASS)  # for rlm
library(performance)  # for model diagnostics
set.seed(123)
```

## Simulate Data: Font Size vs Readability
```{r simulate-data}
n <- 100
font_size <- runif(n, 8, 24)  # font sizes from 8 to 24 pt


readability <- -0.25 * (font_size - 16)^2 + 7 + rnorm(n, 0, 2)  # increased variability

# simulate user-level random noise (e.g. distraction, fatigue)
user_noise <- rnorm(n, 0, 1.5)
readability <- readability + user_noise

# add outliers (e.g. extreme conditions, tech failures)
outlier_indices <- sample(1:n, 7)
readability[outlier_indices] <- readability[outlier_indices] + rnorm(7, 5, 3)

ux_data <- tibble(font_size = font_size, readability = readability)
```

## Plot Raw Data
```{r plot-raw-data}
ggplot(ux_data, aes(x = font_size, y = readability)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Font Size vs. Readability", x = "Font Size (pt)", y = "Readability Score") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("font_size_readability_scatter.png", width = 6, height = 4)
```

## Fit Linear Model
```{r fit-linear}
linear_model <- lm(readability ~ font_size, data = ux_data)

ggplot(ux_data, aes(x = font_size, y = readability)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Linear Model Fit", x = "Font Size", y = "Readability") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("linear_model_fit.png", width = 6, height = 4)
```

## Residual Plot
```{r plot-residuals}
resid_data <- augment(linear_model)

ggplot(resid_data, aes(x = .fitted, y = .resid)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Residuals of Linear Model", x = "Fitted Values", y = "Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("linear_model_residuals.png", width = 6, height = 4)
```

## Fit Polynomial Model
```{r fit-polynomial}
ux_data <- ux_data %>% mutate(font_size_sq = (font_size - mean(font_size))^2)
poly_model <- lm(readability ~ font_size + font_size_sq, data = ux_data)

ggplot(ux_data, aes(x = font_size, y = readability)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x + I((x - mean(x))^2), se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Polynomial Model Fit", x = "Font Size", y = "Readability") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("polynomial_model_fit.png", width = 6, height = 4)
```

## Compare Models
```{r compare-models}
broom::glance(linear_model)
broom::glance(poly_model)
```

## Robust Regression Model
```{r robust-model}
robust_model <- rlm(readability ~ font_size + font_size_sq, data = ux_data)
summary(robust_model)
```
